summary: Quantum eMotion Corp, a Canadian quantum cybersecurity developer, filed a Form 6-K with interim financial statements and MD&A for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report for a foreign private issuer, containing financial results and operational updates, including the appointment of a Director of Product Development. No special-situation transaction or corporate action is disclosed. The exhibits include standard CEO/CFO certifications. This is not a special-situation filing; it is an ordinary earnings and operational update.
